reply_text: @Sofia, the lamp delivery at door 6 was on **Pellow** (Pellow Home Living, the Mid-Atlantic home goods account), not Pellucid. Kwame and you settled this in #coastal-team on Feb 17: Pellucid Harbor Logistics is the Gulf Coast terminal account, and the container pickup was theirs too. Both businesses use the "PHL" acronym, which is why the two got mixed up.
